description: Machine manifest of the §22 required conformance tests (FACTORY-LOOP-SPEC §22, tests 1-27). Every numbered case has exactly one manifest entry; the hidden adversarial suite (.factory/tests/test-factory-adversarial.py) and its shell entrypoint (.factory/tests/test-factory-adversarial.sh) reject a manifest with any missing, duplicate, or skipped case. Each entry names the test method that proves the case non-vacuously against the real authority in fresh subprocesses and test-owned temporary repositories.

cases.title: planner, developer, tester, and auditor receive fresh processes and only allowed authoritative inputs
automatic memory/session resume is disabled
plan-derived task selection is deterministic
no runtime task ledger is read or created
a discovered finding reaches the next developer only through a revised plan
empty runnable work reaches verification and audit instead of spinning
external blockers terminate the final round nonzero without evidence elevation
pass is impossible with unresolved mandatory findings
one-writer locking and serialized builds hold under concurrency attempts
TERM, INT, and HUP reach and reap the full model process group
timeout and crash recovery preserve dirty work
stale, forged, symlinked, oversized, wrong-owner, wrong-mode, or mismatched state fails closed
Canonical Ollama check, conditional bounded wait, and final check run before every model invocation; every failure launches zero models
credential tool-call blocking and tool-result redaction remain active
exact-commit runner, visual, installed, and audit receipts retain their existing trust semantics
no model completion token can bypass deterministic gates

finite campaigns terminate within configured round and attempt bounds, including planning failure, clean task failure, dirty interruption, verification blocked, verification infrastructure failure, audit findings, audit blocked, and success fixtures
migration preserves the active plan, Git commits, dirty work, evidence, and external blockers without importing Ralph memories or runtime tasks
an untrusted leaf inherits no lock descriptor or lock environment, and a separately opened repository descriptor cannot unlock the holder
a double-fork or setsid descendant is terminated or detected, and recovery cannot proceed while it survives
the delivered task excerpt is byte-bound to the committed plan and substitution or paraphrase fails closed
the model can read current authoritative inputs but cannot read .ralph/, .factory-state/, prior scratchpads, runtime tasks, memories, or legacy campaign state
a mid-phase control-state mutation, mode/owner/link change, counter rewind, campaign-option mismatch, branch mismatch, or specification/plan-base change fails closed
synthetic Ollama credentials appear in neither child argv nor child environments during --check and --wait
the immutable verifier descriptor rejects pathname replacement
Git commit-boundary bypass attempts remain rejected
no new implementation depends on Ralph lifecycle events, tokens, shims, runtime tasks, or memories
